name: Nash Turbeville
headline: A piano. A voice. Your kind of night.
bio: I'm Nash, a cruise ship singing pianist and dueling pianist. From solo piano evenings to the shared energy of dueling pianos, I bring live music and audience connection to the room. I also perform with J’s Dueling Pianos.
teachingBio: Alongside performing, I consider private teaching opportunities on a personal, case-by-case basis. Get in touch to discuss your goals and availability.
